newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Afghan, Filipino for drugs, murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Afghan, Filipino for drugs, murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded an Afghan drug smuggler and a Filipino convicted of murder, raising to 61 the number of executions this year in the conservative Islamic country.

An Interior Ministry statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said the Afghan man was beheaded in the capital Riyadh after being convicted of smuggling an unspecified amount of heroin into the kingdom.
A separate ministry statement read on Saudi state television said the Filipino was beheaded in Riyadh for stabbing and choking to death an Egyptian man.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug smugglers and other criminals. It executed 68 people in 1996.
